item.title: Entrepreneurship and the Creation of Decent Work for All
item.content:encoded:
This multi-journal collection examines how entrepreneurship can contribute to achieving decent work for all, aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 8. The initiative recognizes that labor markets and employment quality are constantly affected by societal, environmental, and economic changes, and that entrepreneurship may play a key role in creating quality employment opportunities, particularly in uncertain times.

The collection seeks interdisciplinary research exploring the complex relationship between entrepreneurial activities and working conditions. It invites submissions addressing various dimensions of this relationship, including employment discrimination, labor rights, business organization models, remote work arrangements, and the broader impacts of entrepreneurial ventures on labor markets and worker welfare.

Appel publié par Small Business Economics. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Equal pay for work of equal value
  • Gender discrimination in employment
  • Immigration and employment
  • Labor shortages after COVID-19
  • Modern slavery and child labor
  • Labor policy
  • Entrepreneurial enterprises, SMEs, and family businesses
  • Global entrepreneurial firms
  • Remote work
  • Opportunity entrepreneurship
  • Positive and negative externalities of new businesses
